spans.s: शिम्बः [śimbḥ], A kind of large shrub (चक्रमर्द). -म्बा A pod, legume; (also शिम्बिः f. in this sense); तीराश्मन्तकशिम्बि- चुम्बितमुखा धावन्त्यपः पूर्णिकाः
सिम [sima], a. Every, all, whole, entire.
सीमा [sīmā], 1 Boundary, limit, border, margin, frontier.
A mound or ridge serving to mark the boundary of a field, village &c.; सीमां प्रति समुत्पन्ने विवादे
The bounds of morality or decorum, limits of propriety.
The highest or utmost limit, highest point, climax; सीमेव पद्मासनकौशलस्य
An ornament of the hair; L. D. B. -Comp. -अज्ञानम् ignorance of boundaries; सीमाज्ञाने नृणां वीक्ष्य नित्यं लोके विपर्ययम्
the ceremony of worshipping or honouring a village boundary.

worshipping the bridegroom when he arrives at the village boundary. -उल्लङ्घनम् transgressing or leaping over a boundary, crossing a frontier (now performed on the Dasarā day).-कृषाण a. ploughing on the border of a land mark.-निश्चयः a legal decision with respect to land-marks or boundaries. -बन्धः a depository of rules of morality.-लिङ्गम् a boundary-mark, land-mark; उपच्छन्नानि चान्यानि सीमालिङ्गानि कारयेत्
. -वादः a dispute about boundaries. -विनिर्णयः settlement of disputed boundary-questions; सीमाविनिर्णयं कुर्युः प्रयता राजसंनिधौ
. -विवादः litigation about boundaries. ˚धर्मः the law regarding disputes about boundaries.
वृक्षः a tree serving as a boundary-mark; सीमावृक्षांश्च कुर्वीत न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थकिंशुकान्
(fig.) one whose example is followed by others. -संधिः the meeting of two boundaries; सीमासंधिषु कार्याणि देवतायतनानि च
. -सेतुः a ridge or causeway serving as a boundary; सामन्तप्रत्ययो ज्ञेयः सीमासेतुविनिर्णयः
सिमिसिमायते [simisimāyatē], Den. Ā. To be convulsed, feel a chilling sensation.
सिमीकः [simīkḥ], A kind of small worm.
An ant or a similar small insect. -का (f.)
An abscess on the underside of the tongue;
सीमन् [sīman], f. [सि-इमनि पृषो˚ न गुणो दीर्घश्च Tv.]
A boundary &c.; see सीमा; सीमानमत्यायतयो$त्यजन्तः Śi.3.57; see निःसीमन् also.

The acrotum; सीम्नि पुष्कलको हतः Sk.; (for other senses see सीमा below). -Comp. -लिङ्गम् a boundary mark, land-mark; ग्रामीयककुलानां च समक्षं सीम्नि साक्षिणः । प्रष्टव्याः सीमलिङ्गानि तयोश्चैव विवादिनोः ॥
The parting line of the hair; the hair parted on each side of the head so as to leave a line; सीमन्तः केशवेशे, सीमान्तो$न्यः Sk. (Mar. भांग); सीमन्ते च त्वदुपगमजं यत्र नीपं वधूनाम्
. -Comp. -उन्नयनम् 'parting of the hair', one of the twelve Saṁskāras or purificatory rites observed by women in the fourth, sixth or eighth month of their pregnancy.
सीमन्तकः [sīmantakḥ], 1 N. of a particular kind of inhabitant of hell.
To part or mark by a line (in general); सेनां सीमन्तयन्नरेः Kīr.
Parted or marked by a line; समीरसीमन्तितकेतकीकाः (प्रदेशाः) Śi.3.8; रथाङ्गसीमन्तितसान्द्रकर्दमान् (पथः)
सीमन्तिनी [sīmantinī], A woman; मा स्म सीमन्तिनी काचिज्जनयेत् पुत्र- मीदृशम्
